name: Eousdryosaurus
sum: A small basal iguanodontian from the Late Jurassic Lourinhã Formation of Portugal, known from one partial skeleton.
wsnote: About 1.6 m long, comparable to immature Dryosaurus and Dysalotosaurus; the femur is 188.5 mm and the tibia 200 mm.
holotype: SHN(JJS)-170, a partial skeleton from Upper Jurassic rocks of western Portugal.
biology: A small dryosaurid; the sources consulted do not describe its habits.
author: Escaso et al. 2014

sources.text: F. Escaso, F. Ortega, and P. Dantas, E. Malafaia, B. Silva, J. M. Gasulla, P. Mocho, I. Narvaeza, J. L. Sanz. 2014. A new dryosaurid ornithopod (Dinosauria, Ornithischia) from the Late Jurassic of Portugal. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 34(5):1102-1112
